testRecord.classification: IDTS Bug Report / SAP CAP Backend

expectedResult: Smart Assign explanations are grounded in candidate capability, availability, workload, and confidence; cancelling causes no assignment/history/notification mutation.
actualResult: Opening Smart Assign on the valid assigned BUG-0026 returned a visible raw-like `Communication error: 401 error` instead of candidate explanations, so Cancel could not be exercised. After closing and refreshing, BUG-0026 remained Assigned to SangVN with unchanged classification.
reviewBoundary: The protected Object Page remained authenticated after refresh, so this is scoped to the Smart Assign request rather than evidence of an expired application session. DonHV must classify provider/service authorization root cause.

evidence.description: Smart Assign opening failed with a visible 401 communication error.

privacyReview.notes: Screenshot shows controlled Bug values and generic 401 text; no endpoint, token, email, or session identifier.
